wanted.rationale: total-series cap sized above the committed universe's worst grid (29 underlyings x 105 as_of Fridays x ~1 monthly in-band expiry x 7 strikes x 2 sides ~ 42,630): a guard against a runaway walk, not a trim — the work manifest records the actual selection size

dte_min.rationale: the protocol candidate band's lower DTE edge (capture bridge DTE_MIN)

dte_max.rationale: the protocol candidate band's upper DTE edge (capture bridge DTE_MAX)

strike_band.rationale: ATM +/- 3 distinct strikes per expiry — a RANK in the ladder, never an absolute strike distance

sides.rationale: calls and puts at every selected strike
